# Commit message deny-list for Orange Rails (DL-0855)
# ERE patterns, one per line. Lines beginning with # are comments.
# Extend this file as new internal identifiers are added.
# Workflow: .github/workflows/commit-msg-scan.yml

# ---------- Internal hostnames ----------
\bruche\b
\bbb-us\b
\bjarvis\b

# ---------- Tailnet IPs and MagicDNS ----------
# Matches any 100.x.x.x address (Tailscale CGNAT range)
100\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+
# Tailscale MagicDNS domain suffix
\.ts\.net

# ---------- Supabase project identifiers ----------
fzwmnzmtqidumdqjdddz
lcdicqalreskibdfxkzb

# ---------- Private wiki and Zulip server URLs ----------
wiki\.orangerails\.dev
wiki\.orangeway\.dev
waggle\.orangerails\.com
waggle\.orangeway\.dev

# ---------- Ride session seat names ----------
# sp-1 through sp-10 are internal ride seats and must not appear publicly
\bsp-([1-9]|10)\b

# ---------- Zulip message-ID citations ----------
# Matches patterns like "msg 2467" or "msg_id: 12345"
\bmsg\s+[0-9]{4,}\b
\bmessage[_-]id\s*[:=]\s*[0-9]+\b
